name: application-onboarding-checklist
title: Onboarding Checklist
description: Dismissible getting-started checklist components with progress indicators for driving activation in SaaS dashboards.
useWhen: Dismissible getting-started checklist components with progress indicators for driving activation in SaaS dashboards.
avoidWhen: Avoid onboarding checklist when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Onboarding Checklist uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
